modalities.evidence: Multi-b-value longitudinal test-retest diffusion MRI brain dataset

output.population: Eleven healthy volunteers (5F/6M, aged: 24–48/23–45) with no reported neurological or neuropsychiatric disorders
output.summary: Longitudinal test-retest multi-b-value diffusion MRI of the brain in healthy volunteers, acquired over four sessions on a 3T scanner, with raw and preprocessed NIfTI data, DTI parameters and tractography derivatives.
